event_state_rule: For each retained candidate, reconstruct the repository lockfile at the latest lockfile commit at or before advisory publication. Recompute reachability and depth. An advisory is a true standing-loss event only if OSV confirms it affects a package version reachable in that event-time graph. Otherwise it is a stale-watchlist negative control.
selection_rule: For each source, query OSV for every registry package@version reachable in the frozen 2025-01-01 dependency state. Fetch full records for matching IDs, retain advisories published inside the frozen event window, sort by (published,id,package,version), deduplicate by (advisory_id,package), and take the first 12. No replacement.
snapshot_rule: latest default-branch commit at or before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z
